description: Ajust is an Australian consumer advocacy service that helps people resolve complaints with businesses, including refunds, cancellations, billing disputes, and warranty issues. It offers free self-help guides and an AI-assisted case workflow, and also provides partner integrations for approved backends.
summary: Ajust exposes two public streamable-HTTP MCP endpoints on agent.ajust.com.au with no sign-in, plus a partner-only HTTP API on api.ajust.com.au that uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials / bearer tokens for backend access.
